loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The pipeline consists of three layers: (1) theInput Processorresolves ambiguous queries, (2) theAnalytical Agentgenerates tool calls executed in a local sandbox, and (3) theResponse Generatorsynthesizes a natural language answer.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The LLM decomposes such queries into a sequence of atomic sub-tasks, each mapped to a single function call.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: then walk through the three layers of the pipeline: Input Processor, Analytical Agent, and Response Generator.
